agentContract.humanReadableSurface: app.js rendered documentation routes fed by packages/content/content/component-copy.json
agentContract.syncRule: Machine-readable contracts in packages/specs/specs/unison.system.json govern technical validity. Visible documentation and fixtures in packages/content/content/component-copy.json may explain and demonstrate those contracts, but cannot introduce states, props, variants, foundations, or rejection rules that contradict the spec. packages/audit/scripts/audit-system.js must verify the crossing before content is considered trustworthy.
rejectIf: The artifact exposes raw token values as public API.
The artifact skips foundations or primitive dependencies.
The artifact uses emoji or text placeholders instead of governed iconography.
The artifact requires animation to understand a task.
The artifact lacks accessibility behavior for name, role, state, focus, keyboard, contrast, reduced motion, or recovery.
The artifact creates a chart without an accessible text summary.
The artifact creates a map without permission-denied and fallback-list behavior.
